about: Board 3's own words and the files each panel reads. work/build/scripts/phase-3/board_3_build.py reads this file on every run; every number, picture and quoted word on the board comes from the files named under slots, read at build time. A {name} in a sentence is filled from those files. Codes in a 'refs' field print only in the small reference lines. The editor owns these words once the first full build lands; the data lead's decisions file holds panel 1's items and panel 6's counts.
title: Edition 06 Board 3

cover.title: Chapter 14 finished, chapter 15 whole
deck: Rounds 4 and 5 finished chapter 14: its last {n_forms} forms, a guide to choosing a chart, the palette plate and three charts in full. Chapter 15 now holds all {n_15} of its rules, and chapter 11 has two new trackers.
Panel 1 asks for {n_replies_w} replies. The panels after it show the work those replies rest on, at true size, then the chapter’s weight, the count of its examples, the scores and what was tested.
cover.minutes: The {n_replies_w} numbered replies at the top of panel 1 take about {p1_top_min} to read ({p1_top_words} words), and every item in the panel about {p1_min} minutes ({p1_words} words with its folds closed), at 200 words a minute. Pictures show at true size; where one is wider than your window, its frame scrolls sideways.

ch15.title: Chapter 15, all {n_15} rules
ch15.lede: Chapter 15 sets how the guide draws the systems atlas: loops, chains, layers, reforms and the routes to change. Each rule shows its title with its correct and failure plates, photographed from the final build at a 1440 px window.
ch15.phone_lede: The plates a phone reader uses most, at a 390 px window: the ones a reader steps through, chooses in or reads as a list.
ch15.recon_lede: Rule 15.25 checks every earlier drawing of the atlas against the atlas’s model. Its two tables follow as the final build prints them: what the earlier page showed, what the model holds, and where the guide applies the answer. Two rows concern the atlas’s next version, V7.1. Row 56, the who-acts words on reform routes, is the row panel 1 asks you to add, and row 57, the Article V route, is already on that list from your board 2 answers.
